tripSummary: This four-day journey through Maharashtra offers a perfect blend of heritage, nature, and local flavours for a couple. You will experience the rich history of the old city, the scenic beauty of hill stations, and the charm of mountain viewpoints.
routeReason: The route moves logically from the cultural heart of {{city:pune}} to the nearby hills of {{city:lonavala}}, before heading south to the serene environment of {{city:mahabaleshwar}}.

days.intro: Begin your journey by immersing yourselves in the rich traditions and flavours of the old city. It is a wonderful way to connect with the local heritage together.
Enjoy a change of pace as you head to the hills to explore ancient rock-cut architecture and dramatic cliffside views. The fresh air and elevated scenery provide a refreshing escape.
Continue your adventure in the strawberry capital, where you can enjoy relaxing lakeside moments and indulge in local produce. It is a peaceful day dedicated to the natural beauty of the region.
Conclude your trip with a visit to a breathtaking viewpoint that offers panoramic vistas. It is the perfect final memory before you depart.
